errors: stanza2: "fazer do inimigo uma criança" mistranslates "child"; the hymn's point is adoption of a foe as God's child, so "filho" is required and "criança" weakens the doctrine
subtitle: "entre as crianças" misrenders Jeremiah 3:19, where "children" means sons or heirs ("filhos"), not young children
stanza5: "E pisotearmos seu sangue" is a wrong verb form (personal infinitive) after "desprezaremos"; it should be the future "pisotearemos"
stanza1: "Nossas vidas, a Satanás, como escravizadas" is a stilted, word-for-word line
stanza4: "Jesus se compromete pelos pecadores" is unnatural and unclear for "undertakes", which means taking up the sinners' cause
stanza2: "And" at the start of the stanza's first line is kept as "E", which is acceptable, but the stanza is prose rendering with no meter or rhyme
stanza5: "Mas uma coisa mais" is awkward for "Yet one thing more"; "Mas ainda uma coisa" would be natural
stanza1: "ao Satanás" uses an article before the name, which is unidiomatic in Portuguese; it should be "a Satanás"
stanza2: "tornar um inimigo em filho" is a faulty construction; it should be "tornar um inimigo filho" or "fazer de um inimigo um filho"
stanza4: "para que pudéssemos viver" shifts the tense slightly from "that we may live"; "para que vivamos" is closer
stanza4: "Perdoai" is a plural or archaic imperative addressed to God where the singular "Perdoa" would be expected and consistent with the singular address to the Father
stanza2: the opening "And" of "And can such sinners be restored" is dropped
subtitle: "Como posso colocar-te" is less faithful than "Como te porei" for the future "How shall I put thee" and misses the traditional Bible wording of Jeremiah 3:19
stanza3: "há de provar-se eficaz" is a stiff, literal rendering of "shall effectual prove"
